steps.prompt: Is $45 + 28 = 47 + 26$ true? How can you tell without working out both sides?

cards.title: The equals sign is a balance
cards.body: $=$ means "is the same as". Picture a see-saw: both sides must weigh the same. $45 + 28 = ? + 30$: the left side is $73$, so $? = 43$.

try.prompt: How much did it go up by?

steps.text: To keep the balance, the second number goes down by the same: $28 - 2$.

cards.title: The common trap
cards.body: Some people see $45 + 28 = ? + 30$ and write $73$, the answer to the left side. But then the right side is $73 + 30 = 103$. The missing number must make the right side $73$ too.

prompts: Explain what the equals sign means, using a see-saw.
